professionalSummary.text: Experienced product manager with a proven track record in owning and prioritising alert‑review workflow roadmaps, driving release reviews, and improving alert closure rates within service‑level targets.
professionalSummary.witness: Owned the alert-review workflow roadmap for the transaction monitoring product, prioritising the backlog each sprint with the compliance operations lead and publishing the roadmap to the compliance director.

experienceHighlights.text: Owned the alert‑review workflow roadmap and prioritised the backlog each sprint with compliance operations.
experienceHighlights.witness: Owned the alert-review workflow roadmap for the transaction monitoring product, prioritising the backlog each sprint with the compliance operations lead and publishing the roadmap to the compliance director.

experienceHighlights.text: Ran six release reviews with engineering and compliance operations, recording decisions and open items.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran the release review for each of the six workflow releases with engineering and compliance operations, recording decisions and open items in the release record.

experienceHighlights.text: Increased alerts closed within target from 71% to 88% over four months post‑release.
experienceHighlights.witness: The share of alerts closed within the service-level target rose from 71 percent to 88 percent over the four months after the alert-grouping release, per the compliance operations monthly report against its documented baseline of 71 percent.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated releases with engineering manager and compliance operations lead, ensuring alignment on dates and approvals.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated releases with the engineering manager and the compliance operations lead; the engineering manager set release dates and the compliance operations lead approved the rollout to analyst teams.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented known limitations and hand‑over conditions in release notes for each workflow release.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the release notes for each workflow release, including the known limitation that grouped alerts could not be split back into individual alerts, and the hand-over notes for analyst trainers.
